topic: Vitamin aur unki kami se rog
subject: Science
caption:
Vitamin C ki kami se kaunsa rog hota hai? 🤔 Jawaab hai Scurvy, lekin aur bhi vitamins hain jo exam mein puche jaate hain!

🍊 Vitamin C ki kami → Scurvy (masudo se khoon, ghaav na bharna)
🦴 Vitamin D ki kami → Rickets (bachchon mein kamzor haddiyan)
👁️ Vitamin A ki kami → Night Blindness (andhere mein na dikhna)
🧠 Trick: C-Scurvy, D-Rickets, A-Night Blindness

Comment karo: Vitamin D ki kami se kaunsa rog hota hai? A) Rickets ya B) Scurvy

first_comment: Answer: A) Rickets. Vitamin D ki kami se Rickets hota hai (bachchon mein haddiyan kamzor ho jaati hain).
